svg.title: Foundations: color roles, type and iconography (Era 3)
svg.desc: Layer 1 shipped perceptual foundations for WFS Family Cookbook Era 3.
svg.text: WFS / Shared Table · Family Cookbook Era 3 (Dual-Mode)
Dual-mode semantic tokens (:root Standard AA default vs. :root[data-contrast="high"] High Contrast AAA).
Ratios shown on #FDFCF0 cream (higher on #FFFFFF). Subtle wells use charcoal-50/100 (#FAF8F5 / #F3EFEA); disabled uses #E5DFD7 / #524A43.
2 · Dual-mode brand semantic roles (Standard AA default → High Contrast AAA)
Hearth · Standard AA → High Contrast AAA
Sunlight · Standard AA → High Contrast AAA
Garden · Cooled Herb Roles (#4E6E52 / #3D5940 Standard AA → #324D36 / #243A27 High Contrast AAA)
garden-line sharpens #C7CFB0 → #324D36 in High Contrast (garden-ink reaches 8.34:1 on sage-50, 7.41:1 on sage-100, 9.33:1 on white).
All shipped UI components use --role-* semantic tokens, enforced continuously by tokens.test.ts and visual-contract.test.ts (allowlist empty).
3 · Type scale, context-paired Ready in, 48px targets & focus
24px glyph inside >= 48 x 48 CSS px box
4 · Bottom navigation (.glass-nav + 3-state medallion) & shipped Lucide icons
Standard .glass-nav uses frosted cream; :root[data-contrast="high"] switches to opaque #FDFCF0 + #6E645B top border (no blur).
Companion boards: 02 Surfaces, Controls & Recovery · 03 Supper Plan & Week · 04 Recipe Cards & Detail.
